URL: https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-july-27-2026

ISW Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, July 27, 2026 (key takeaways):

Russian strikes: Russia launched 147 drones against Ukraine overnight on July 26 to 27. Ukrainian forces downed 123 drones; 21 struck various locations across multiple oblasts.

Front line — Kostiantynivka-Druzhkivka direction: Russian forces conducted an infiltration mission southeast of Vasiutynske. The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed seizure of Torske; ISW "has not observed geolocated evidence confirming this claim."

Front line — Pokrovsk direction: Russian forces "continued offensive operations in the Pokrovsk direction on July 26 and 27 but did not make confirmed advances." A Russian milblogger claimed westward movement near Shevchenko (unconfirmed).

Overall assessment: "Neither Russian nor Ukrainian forces made confirmed advances on July 27." Russian offensive momentum has slowed; operations limited primarily to infiltration attempts rather than territorial breakthroughs.
